scope: Display-Manager, nativer Treiberbesitzer und Queue behalten jeweils ihren eigenen Zustand. 211 Funktionen bleiben erhalten; 155 davon liegen in 12 fachlichen Operationsdateien.

implementation.roots: The three existing State/type/impl/import roots remain separate. Child files contain only original complete operations; direct compile-time aliases preserve existing entry paths. No new state, copy, dispatch layer or runtime object.
implementation.lifetime: Original exact boot/restore identity, CPU-write admission, queue submission, IRQ epochs, reset/retention and terminal release acknowledgements remain at their original boundaries.

display/manager.rs.single_state_root: Every original non-function item/impl/import line unchanged except blank separation. Children contain only original complete functions, docs/attributes and parent import.
display/manager.rs.signature_policy: Exact type/signature tokens after required visibility and rustfmt whitespace/trailing comma only. No body formatting, algorithm, owner or lifecycle change allowed.

display/native_driver.rs.single_state_root: Every original non-function item/impl/import line unchanged except blank separation. Children contain only original complete functions, docs/attributes and parent import.
display/native_driver.rs.signature_policy: Exact type/signature tokens after required visibility and rustfmt whitespace/trailing comma only. No body formatting, algorithm, owner or lifecycle change allowed.

display/queue.rs.single_state_root: Every original non-function item/impl/import line unchanged except blank separation. Children contain only original complete functions, docs/attributes and parent import.
display/queue.rs.signature_policy: Exact type/signature tokens after required visibility and rustfmt whitespace/trailing comma only. No body formatting, algorithm, owner or lifecycle change allowed.

source_audit.preserved: Every original complete free function, type/signature, attribute/safety document and state/type/impl/import root remains. Only required child visibility and exact one-level super qualification change. Direct compile-time reexports retain used old paths; no new mutable state, copy, runtime dispatch or owner/lifetime edge.
source_audit.test_policy: Affected exact body/signature/state/path/attribute proofs and existing strict compiler/layout checks plus exactly1final common native SMP4 STANDARD. No new suite or repeated unrelated full catalog; no fresh physical hardware/exhaustive interleaving claim.

compiler_preflight.failure: Strict clippy rejected an unused private root alias modes::change.
compiler_preflight.correction: Removed only that unused generated alias. The original change function and its local callers remain in modes.rs. No lint relaxation, function/body or runtime behavior change.

validation.native_acceptance: Actual final SMP4 STANDARD on current physically verified image; extra affected cases only when documented as needed.

comparison_previous.observation: One final run per artifact; descriptive comparison without causal speedup/parity claim or selection rerun. Original workloads/reference/STDCHILD unchanged.

test_policy: Affected exact body/signature/state/path/attribute proofs and existing strict compiler/layout checks plus exactly1final common native SMP4 STANDARD. No new suite or repeated unrelated full catalog; no fresh physical hardware/exhaustive interleaving claim.
performance_assessment: Changed code layout may affect performance. Exactly one final STANDARD Suite 2 SMP4 with unchanged full export and lossless GET 5/30/6 valid. Original algorithms remain; no causal speedup or parity claim from a single run.
limits: No fresh physical GPU, scanout, HDMI, reset or exhaustive interleaving qualification. Exact source/state/attribute proofs and current common native STANDARD do not replace those hardware-specific observations.
